Container.Name: sonarr-torrent-guard
Container.Overview: Sonarr Torrent Guard. Starts in dry-run to test both Sonarr owners and qBittorrent without removing, blocklisting or searching. This same container name and appdata are intended for ongoing use after separately approved live configuration. No web UI yet. Supply private connection settings below; do not share an edited template.

Config.Name: Private appdata
Config.Description: Create this dedicated directory owned by UID/GID 1000:1000, mode 0700, before first start. Never map a whole appdata share or media/download directory. Preserve this appdata for ongoing use; do not overwrite or copy a live journal while its worker is running.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Use dry-run for initial verification; the reviewed container live gate remains disabled until separately approved activation.

Config.Name: Configuration source
Config.Description: env uses these private settings. file preserves an existing private connections.json. Never rename owners or reset journals to bypass holds.

Config.Name: Indexer source policy
Config.Description: Identified indexers are public unless listed as private. Explicitly selecting this policy migrates old allowlist settings; changed policy requires fresh live authorization. Missing or ambiguous history remains protected.

Config.Name: Sonarr HD private indexers
Config.Description: JSON array of protected private indexer names. Other identified Sonarr indexers are treated as public; missing or ambiguous history remains protected. Include private aliases such as freeleech names.

Config.Name: Sonarr UHD private indexers
Config.Description: JSON array of protected private indexer names. Other identified Sonarr indexers are treated as public; missing or ambiguous history remains protected. Include private aliases such as freeleech names.
